Reports har step ki start date se chalti hain: weekly har 7 din baad, monthly har 28 din (4 hafte) baad — monthly wale din dono report ek saath, raat 8:30 PM. Success = 80%+. Dipanshu ki report uski pehli aadat ke din se alag chalti hai (weekly 7 din, monthly 28 din). Ye reports sirf padhne ke liye hain (badli nahi ja sakti).
Roz subah 6:00 AM par "Aaj ka Plan" (aaj ke saare Routine + To-Do + Habit + Practice ki list) email + Telegram par aata hai. Roz shaam 7:00 PM par hisaab ki email (Routine + To-Do + Habit + Practice) aur ✅/❌ jawab ka link. Neeche se test ke liye abhi bhi bhej sakte ho.
Test: email bhejo → link kholo → ✅/❌ (reason ke saath) → Bhejo → yahan "sync karo" dabao. Phir Routine/To-Do/Habit tab me ✅ ya ❌ + reason dikhega.
Achanak chutti / holiday ho to ye kaam us din ki subah ki list, raat ke ✅/❌ aur report me jud jayenge. Telegram se: aaj holiday hai · kal holiday hai.

Off (default) = ⏭ Step aur ⟲ Reset icons hidden rahenge, sirf ▶ Play aur 📅 Calendar dikhenge. On = dono wapas dikhenge.
🧱 Replay Base Timeframe
Base se CHHOTI koi bhi TF replay mein disabled ho jaayegi (uska data load hi nahi hoga). Base badalte hi replay is date se fresh restart hota hai.
🔔 Market Closed Popup
On (default) = 3:30 PM par Continue/Pause/Stop popup dikhega. Off = popup skip ho jayega, replay khud-ba-khud agle trading session mein continue karega (jaise Continue dabaya ho).
